policy.admission_rule: A benchmark is measured only after independent correctness gates pass on source-bound inputs.

suites.title: Neural WASM execution and microstep
suites.admission: every source/step matches v51 and Wasmtime

suites.title: Constructed gate falsification
suites.source_binding: WASM source digest + fixed gate mutation
suites.admission: all target opcodes activated; report every undetected case

suites.title: Blinded neural behavior → independently proved symbolic WASM → neural microstep
suites.source_binding: original and recovered canonical WASM SHA-256 and bytes, Z3 formula digest, fixed v49 weight digest, Git commit/tree
suites.admission: synthesizer sees oracle I/O but no original source, weights, manifests or traces; solver proves typed source-to-symbolic candidate across full i32 domain; original and recovered Wasmtime and V58 finite traces agree; do not infer neural all-input proof or unknown-model decompilation

suites.title: Failure-complete blinded neural-to-symbolic synthesis experiment
suites.source_binding: original source WASM bytes plus SHA-256, fixed bit-VM hash, Git tree, per-attempt audit and independent archive verifier
suites.admission: all attempts preserved, cubic negative rejected, source digests match known source inputs, independent SMT/Wasmtime/v58 reruns every successful receipt, invalid protocol/trace results never count as scientific rejection

suites.title: Proof-gated original-versus-recovered WASM cost and specialization amortization
suites.source_binding: independently replayed v50-v58 original/recovered WASM receipt with exact Git tree and Z3 proof hash
suites.admission: independently reverify archive typed i32 proof and finite execution traces before any timing; pair within same engine/input; never call these experiments neural-weight specialization; no optimization speedups without actual measurements

suites.title: Typed Semantic IR decode/reencode fidelity
suites.admission: canonical roundtrip + semantic parity + corrupt IR rejection

suites.title: Independent native C++17 kernel correctness and cost
suites.admission: pretrained model parity before timing; no mixed-precision numerical claims

suites.title: Causal intervention and mechanistic model validity
suites.admission: heldout separation and negative controls must pass

suites.title: Blinded behavior-to-symbolic recovery
suites.source_binding: oracle I/O only; separate program verifier
suites.admission: no source or weights leaked to synthesis; independent all-i32 SMT check

suites.title: Visual neural graph editor responsiveness
suites.admission: visually identical scene and interaction sequence

suites.title: Multiplayer graph consistency and synchronization
suites.source_binding: operation log + seeds + network impairment policy
suites.admission: all clients converge; no silent lost updates

suites.title: Evidence provenance and tamper resistance
suites.source_binding: exact Git tree/commit and raw data SHA-256
suites.admission: all mutated artifacts rejected or explicitly marked superseded

suites.title: Inference model reuse and multi-session isolation
suites.admission: no shared state leakage, exact bounded numerical reference parity

suites.title: IR lowering and rewrite profitability
suites.source_binding: typed source tree + policy digest + rewrite log
suites.admission: independent semantic equivalence before speed claims

suites.title: Cross-platform and future hardware portability
suites.admission: do not claim unsupported GPU, optical or accelerator execution

priority: Only after verified v50-to-v58 roundtrip receipts exist, compare original/recovered canonical WASM costs within Wasmtime and fixed-weight v58 execution and report source-size tradeoffs, regressions and recovery amortization.
Run the v50-to-v58 blinded neural-symbolic roundtrip with independent full-i32 Z3 proof and finite Wasmtime/v58 replay; record all failed attempts and grammar limitations.
Keep correctness and research-integrity failures as hard gates, not weighted score dimensions.
Complete local measured v58 neural VM regression and export immutable evidence.
Add typed Semantic IR roundtrip and native replay adapters to the same benchmark artifact schema.
Add model causality negative-control benchmark adapter before reporting a mechanism recovery score.
Extend UI and collaboration benchmarks with deterministic captured workloads after correctness definitions exist.
